highlights: Beautiful view of hills and valleys

attractions.name: Eravikulam National Park
attractions.description: Home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr and stunning hill views

attractions.name: Tea Museum by Tata
attractions.description: Discover Munnar's tea heritage and enjoy a fresh brew
attractions.entry_fee: ₹75 for adults, ₹35 for children, ₹20 for camera use

attractions.name: Mattupetty Dam
attractions.description: The broad reservoir reflects surrounding hills and tea estates, creating one of Munnar's most scenic landscapes. Optional speed boating available.
attractions.entry_fee: Entry Free | Speed boating extra (~₹500–1000 depending on boat type)
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Echo Point
attractions.description: Surrounded by mist-covered hills and calm waters, famous for its natural echo phenomenon. The area features tea stalls, mountain breeze and beautiful lake views.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Kundala Lake
attractions.description: A tranquil lake surrounded by rolling tea gardens and lush greenery

attractions.name: Anakulam Jeep Safari
attractions.description: A scenic off-road adventure where you might spot wild elephants bathing in the river

attractions.name: Rose Garden
attractions.description: Meticulously maintained garden nestled amidst rolling hills with stunning collection of roses in various hues and sizes. Features other flowering plants with winding paths and panoramic views of tea gardens and mist-covered mountains

attractions.name: Kolukkumalai Tea Estate
attractions.description: Perched high in Theni district of Tamil Nadu near Munnar, renowned for producing world's highest-elevation tea. Visitors can witness traditional tea processing methods and sample distinct flavorful tea
attractions.hours: 7am to 6 pm Mon- Saturday. Closed on Sundays
attractions.entry_fee: Rs. 100 per person for tea factory visit

attractions.name: Attukad Waterfalls
attractions.description: Majestic cascade nestled amidst lush greenery of Munnar. Viewpoint offers stunning panoramic vistas. Road leading to falls can be rough

attractions.name: Cheeyappara Waterfalls
attractions.description: Water tumbles down layered rock formations surrounded by thick greenery. Especially dramatic during monsoon and post-monsoon season.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Valara Waterfalls
attractions.description: Located amidst dense forest cover, this stop feels quieter and more natural with the sound of rushing water and cool mountain breeze.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Kallar Waterfalls
attractions.description: A peaceful stop surrounded by rocky streams and thick vegetation. Tea estates begin appearing around the hills in this area.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Blossom Hydel Park
attractions.description: Flower gardens, shaded walking trails and mountain views. The atmosphere becomes especially pleasant towards sunset with cool air and soft golden light over the hills.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: KDHP Tea Museum
attractions.description: Showcases old tea-processing machinery, photographs and stories from the region's plantation history. The aroma of freshly processed tea leaves fills the space.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Eravikulam National Park (Rajamalai)
attractions.description: Rolling grasslands unfold into mountain ridges with postcard-perfect scenery. Home to the famous Nilgiri Tahr found only in this region. Cool winds and uninterrupted hill views.
source_files: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: Hill roads around Munnar can occasionally become slippery during rain. Wear comfortable footwear with good grip during sightseeing.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: When visiting temples or certain religious spaces, remove footwear before entering and dress modestly with shoulders and knees covered where possible.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx

safety_tips.tip: At places like Periyar Reserve and Eravikulam National Park, avoid loud noise and feeding animals to help preserve the natural experience.
safety_tips._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Rohini_Kerala_All Inclusive Guide.docx
